Tutorial 1 — simple GQ/H profile and compute
============================================

End-to-end walkthrough: connect to RSSeismic, create a blank project, configure GQ/H
layers on Profile 1, select the ChiChi motion, save, and run compute.

**Requires:** RSSeismic with scripting enabled; ChiChi available in the motion library.

Run from the repository root:

.. code-block:: text

   python examples/Tutorial_1/Scripting-Tutorial_1.py

.. literalinclude:: ../../examples/Tutorial_1/Scripting-Tutorial_1.py
   :language: python
   :linenos:
